The '''Nova Star''' was an award granted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to individuals who exhibited exceptional service in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The [[Nova/Legends|Nova]] [[Star/Legends|Star]] Medal of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was a medal awarded by the Galactic Empire to individuals who exhibited exceptional service in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the medal was made available to Imperials who attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of at least [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]]. The medal was in the form of a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] with a stylized [[Color/Legends|blue]] and black ribbon worn around the neck. The medallion was [[Silver/Legends|silver-colored]] in appearance, and imprinted with a black [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]]. The form was similar to those used for Imperial [[commendation]]s, issued to [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who participated in the [[Battle of Restuss]]. The [[Crimson Phoenix]] Medal of the Rebel Alliance served as the Rebel-equivalent to the Nova Star Medal of the Empire.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[W:c:swg:Nova Star Medal of the Empire|Nova Star Medal of the Empire]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3: Smugglers and Scoundrels]] on [[September 27]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> the Nova Star [[W:c:swg:Wearable medal|Medal]] of the [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Empire]] was included as a wearable medal sold by [[Imperial recruiter]]s to players of the Imperial [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]] who attained the [[W:c:swg:Faction rank|rank]] of at least sergeant major. The medal was available for the standard price of 160,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but the cost of [[W:c:swg:Imperial faction items|Imperial faction items]] would fluctuate depending on the [[W:c:swg:Planetary control game|planetary control bonus]], and whether or not the player was [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Due to the Empire's [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] policies, [[Alien/Legends|alien]] players were forced to pay an increased [[Species/Legends|racial]] penalty. The [[W:c:swg:Item|item]], when worn as a [[W:c:swg:Necklace|necklace]], provided the player with an increase to certain [[W:c:swg:Attribute|attributes]]. The graphical appearance of the Nova Star Medal of the Empire was identical to the one used for Imperial [[W:c:swg:Commendations|commendations]].<ref name="AED" />
